verdict.rationale: Convex is a database/backend platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server story applies. First-party docs describe a Convex MCP server that exposes tools for AI agents to interact with a deployment, with a documented safety default that blocks production access, and a probe confirms the dedicated docs page exists. Missing for 10: enumeration of the specific tools and setup/connection steps in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Convex Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides several tools that allow AI agents to interact with your Convex deployment.
By default, the MCP server cannot access production deployments. This is a safety measure to prevent accidental modifications to production data.
